messages:
alex.garcia: FYI — customer AcmeCorp opened a ticket: dashboard shows 12.3k tokens for Feb, invoice shows 19.1k. They need this reconciled for month-end reconciliation.
sophia.cs: ack, can you paste the invoice line and the dashboard export?
alex.garcia: Invoice snippet attached in their support ticket: 
```Account,Period,LineItem,Tokens
acme-001,2026-02,standard-requests,19100
```
Dashboard CSV export (our UI):
```account,period,plan,tokens
acme-001,2026-02,standard,12340
```
so ~6.76k token delta. No credits on invoice.
ben_fin: first guess is double-counting in billing job at month boundary or dashboard aggregation cutoff. I can run a quick query against the metering table.
sophia.cs: also check for plan changes or proration events mid-month — that can shift line labels.
ben_fin: running: 
```SELECT account_id, event_type, tokens, timestamp
FROM billing_events
WHERE account_id='acme-001' AND timestamp >= '2026-02-01' AND timestamp < '2026-03-01'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
ben_fin: returned 3 rows that look suspicious — two ingestion events at 2026-02-28T23:58:12Z and 2026-03-01T00:00:05Z with the same job_id.
ben_fin: rows: 
```job_id, account_id, tokens, processed_at
backfill-2026-02-28, acme-001, 6760, 2026-02-28T23:58:12Z
backfill-2026-02-28, acme-001, 6760, 2026-03-01T00:00:05Z
```
jordan_support: that looks like a backfill/rollover duplicate. Did we have the daily backfill job run across the midnight boundary?
devops-bot: deploy: metering-backfill v2.4.1 promoted to prod at 2026-02-28T23:55:00Z by @ci-cd.
emily_billing: follow-up — invoice shows that second record was counted. Dashboard aggregate dedup logic is keyed by ingest_id, but billing job keys by job_id + processed_at which caused both to be counted.
sophia.cs: ah — billing job used processed_at for uniqueness so the late-run duplicate got a new processed_at and was double-counted. Dashboard de-dupe used ingest_id only (same ingest_id so dashboard kept one).
ben_fin: repro steps: 1) schedule backfill started before midnight, 2) retry triggered at 00:00 with same ingest payload but new processed_at, 3) billing pipeline inserted both rows since uniqueness constraint didn't match.
alex.garcia: customer-facing explanation draft: "We found a double-ingest at your account for a 6760-token batch that was processed twice across the billing cutoff. Dashboard collapsed the duplicates; our billing pipeline counted both. We will credit the duplicate 6760 tokens on your invoice."
jordan_support: can we confirm there were no other duplicate batches for same account in Feb? ben_fin: scanning...
ben_fin: quick scan for job_id pattern backfill-2026-02-28 for all accounts: 14 accounts affected, totals range per-account.
emily_billing: we need to scope impact and issue credits where appropriate. Also check for plan tier changes: I see AcmeCorp got an auto-upgrade to "pro" on 2026-02-15 but that only changes pricing, not token counting.
sophia.cs: ok next steps: (1) run dedupe patch on billing job to ignore processed_at variants (2) backfill corrected invoice credits for affected accounts (3) notify impacted customers with credit amounts and RCA.
devops-bot: alert created: #ops-ticket MET-4523 "billing duplicate processed_at de-dupe" assigned to @ben_fin.
ben_fin: I'll open the patch PR for the billing uniqueness check and schedule a safe backfill. Estimated time ~3 hrs.
jordan_support: I'll prepare customer notes and draft email for AcmeCorp. Alex, can you confirm the credit amount and ETA?
alex.garcia: credit will be 6760 tokens equivalent in USD (billing will compute) and ETA for corrected invoice + credit note by EOD PST.
emily_billing: I'll prepare the ledger adjustments and mark entries as "post-period correction". Need legal signoff? probably not for small credits but will route internally.
sophia.cs: nice catch. Add a regression test for the midnight boundary case in the billing test harness.
ben_fin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/812 — includes fix + migration. Planning backfill window at 2026-03-03 02:00 UTC (low traffic).
jordan_support: copy — will send interim message to AcmeCorp: we identified the root cause and are issuing a credit; full follow-up after backfill. :thumbsup:
alex.garcia: thanks team — please post here when credit issued so I can close the ticket.
